title: Lighter vs HyperLiquid — $150 market + limit orders on ETH/BTC through the real UI, with per-venue max-leverage proof and cleanup
description: Drives the actual mobile UI (no controller shortcuts for the trade flow) on Lighter testnet: places a $150 MARKET order on ETH at 40x and a $150 LIMIT order (-2% below mid) on BTC, capturing the leverage bottom sheet on both markets (Lighter max 50x — the 40x quick-select exists and the slider tops at 50x). Verifies venue state semantically (position + resting order), cleans up (closes the ETH position, cancels the BTC order), then switches to HyperLiquid testnet through the venue picker and captures the same leverage sheets for ETH (max 25x — no 40x quick-select) and BTC (max 40x) as the comparison proof. Amounts are typed on the real keypad (delete × 6, then 1-5-0). Run with --record-video=full-run for the video artifact.
